references.text: The parallel text describing the actual execution of the robe's neck opening with a woven edge that could not be torn.
The preceding verse describing the ephod-robe to which the neck opening belongs.
The high priest shall not tear his garments, which relates to the fact that the robe's opening was made so it could not be torn.
The same Hebrew expression for woven work (ma'aseh oreg) is used regarding the tabernacle's textiles.
Jesus' tunic was woven in one piece and was not torn, but lots were cast for it—a possible typological connection to the high priest's robe.
